summary: Iteration 14 verified the Treasury Batch → Wallet Ledger fan-out fix (applyBatchLedger). Created pytest suite covering sweep+conv-USDT pair writes, idempotency on re-PATCH, the new POST /sync-ledger endpoint, and the AED+WIO extend step. Also ran Playwright UI tests confirming the new 'Sync to Wallet Ledger' button works and the merged-feed batch sort surfaces the most recent batch on top. ALL 5 backend tests pass; UI sync button + sort verified end-to-end with a real BPAY-2605-00001 batch.
critical_code_review_comments: applyBatchLedger() correctly gates each of the 4 steps by data availability AND external_ref uniqueness — verified no duplicates on repeated PATCH and on /sync-ledger re-runs.
recordTransferPair / recordConvertPair create the 2 ledger rows with shared external_ref linking — confirmed in DB via /api/wallets/{code}/ledger query.
Treasury.jsx batchTs(b) uses Math.max over 8 event dates — confirmed BPAY-2605-00001 (period_start 2026-05-01, settled 2026-05-28) now bubbles to TOP of the Binance merged feed.
Sync to Wallet Ledger button visible in batch detail modal footer with data-testid='treasury-sync-ledger-btn'. POST .../sync-ledger returns 201 with {synced:true, batch_code}.
seed_data_creation: Created persistent batch BPAY-2605-00001 (id 280bde8d-95aa-4466-a813-d07e5db5a2df) for UI smoke. Pytest fixtures create/cleanup their own TEST batch each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: applyBatchLedger writes 4 ref types: ${code}-SWEEP, -CONV-USDT, -CONV-AED, -WIO. All idempotent via findByExternalRef. Wallet overview is a list of {code,balances:[{coin,balance,tx_count}]}. Wallet ledger endpoint returns plain array. Login response key is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Treasury batch PATCH requires settlement_tx_hash any time received_crypto_amount or usdt_amount is supplied (assertBatchEvidence). If re-patching with only some fields, must include the existing settlement_tx_hash. UI batch detail modal opens by clicking the batch row in the merged feed (Binance/OKX tab).
rca of the issue: User reported BPAY-2605-00001 showed 'Converted to USDT' but Binance USDT was 0. Root cause was applyBatchStatus() only updated recharge.status; it never fanned out to wallet_ledgers. Fix: applyBatchStatus now calls new applyBatchLedger() which idempotently writes per-step ledger pairs using external_ref dedupe. New POST /api/treasury/batches/:id/sync-ledger exposes a manual re-fan for backfill of existing batches. Verified: BTCPAY BTC=-0.03159609 (sweep), BINANCE BTC nets to 0 (sweep + conv), BINANCE USDT increased by 2309.76. All re-runs (PATCH same fields + double /sync-ledger) produce no duplicates.
